newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 30.

text.p: -- Brooklyn Union Gas Co and Long Island Lighting Co (LILCO) agreed to merge to create a $4 billion electric and gas company. The pact calls for 0.803 share of the new holding company to be swapped for each LILCO share, while one share of the new company would be exchanged for each Brooklyn Union share.
Brooklyn Union shares closed at 31-1/8 on Friday. LILCO closed at 19-3/8.

-- Dutch insurer Aegon NV agreed to buy the insurance activities of Providian Corp in a deal worth $3.5 billion. Providian shareholders will receive Aegon shares worth $2.62 billion, and Aegon USA will take over loans worth some $780 million and preferred stock worth around $100 million.
-- Snowboard maker Ride said it expects lower fourth quarter sales and a fourth quarter net loss, including $9 million in charges due a restructuring and write-downs.

-- Nordstrom Inc said late Friday that its fourth quarter earnings would not meet analysts' estimates due to slow holiday sales. According to First Call, analysts had forecast quarterly earnings of about $0.80 a share, versus $0.67 a year ago. Shares closed at 37-1/2.

-- KinderCare and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co amended their merger agreement to pay $19 a share for each share of KinderCare, down from $20.25 in the original agreement. KinderCare shares closed at 19-13/16.
